    WWE NXT Preview, Start Time, How To Watch, Location (11/24)

    Jeremy LambertNovember 24, 2026, 8:00 am
    Facebook X Bluesky

    Viewership information and lineup for the November 24, 2026 episode of WWE NXT.

    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 0:50
    Instaread

    WWE NXT (November 24, 2026)
    Venue: WWE Performance Center
    City: Orlando, FL
    Time: 8pm ET
    How To Watch: CW Network (US), Netflix (International)

    Lineup

    • Noam Dar, Romeo Moreno, Hank Walker & Tank Ledger vs. Vanity Project (Myka Lockwood, Jackson Drake, Brad Baylor & Ricky Smokes)
    • #1 Contender’s Match: Mason Rook vs. Shiloh Hill (Stipulation: Winner faces Grayson Waller for the NXT Title at TLC PLE)
    • NXT Women’s North American Championship: ZARIA (c) vs. Izzi Dame
    • John Cena to make final NXT announcements for John Cena Classic.

    Fightful will have live coverage of NXT beginning at 8 p.m. ET on Tuesday followed by a post-show podcast on our YouTube channel.

    Fans can watch the show commercial-free on Netflix by using NordVPN.com/Fightful.
